hints.title: Partition Indices by Character Type
hints.text: Collect all indices holding alphabetic letters and all indices holding special characters.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Inversion
hints.text: Reverse the letter values across letter indices, and reverse special character values across special indices.

hints.title: Reconstruct Output
hints.text: Rebuild the result array and join into a final string.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def reverseLettersAndSpecial(self, s: str) -> str:
        res = list(s)
        letter_indices = [i for i, c in enumerate(s) if c.isalpha()]
        special_indices = [i for i, c in enumerate(s) if not c.isalpha()]
        
        l, r = 0, len(letter_indices) - 1
        while l < r:
            res[letter_indices[l]], res[letter_indices[r]] = res[letter_indices[r]], res[letter_indices[l]]
            l += 1
            r -= 1
        
        l, r = 0, len(special_indices) - 1
        while l < r:
            res[special_indices[l]], res[special_indices[r]] = res[special_indices[r]], res[special_indices[l]]
            l += 1
            r -= 1
        
        return "".join(res)
```

complexity.notes: Linear index collection and two-pointer reversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Overwriting characters in place without disjoint index tracking causes collisions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Index lists and character array use O(n) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects two-pointer reversal on disjoint index partitions.
